_about: Games tested on a real Wii U, by 3DS program id. title_id, name, product and slug keep the builds the same as the ones already installed; status and note are shown in the app: "Complete" for a game that is finished here, "Plays" for one that was tested and plays. Anything not listed builds as untested.

_cemu.name: Mario Kart 7
_cemu.note: 60 fps in races, with its v1.2 update. From this build, 29 more shaders are built in ahead. No console report yet.

_cemu.name: The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds
_cemu.note: 57 fps. From this build: its top screen no longer flashes onto the GamePad, and 142 shaders met in longer Cemu runs are built in ahead (its lowest fps there went from 26 to 53), against the stutter seen on a console.

_cemu.name: Metroid: Samus Returns
_cemu.note: 30 fps. Objects vanishing for a moment on a console is fixed from this build.

_cemu.name: Kirby: Triple Deluxe
_cemu.note: 59 fps. From this build, 300 more shaders are built in ahead. No console report yet.

_cemu.name: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy
_cemu.note: 54 fps, from this build on: its script threads switch stacks, and it now builds the way that needs.

_cemu.name: Animal Crossing: New Leaf
_cemu.note: 36 fps with its update. Busy towns are slow on a console.

_cemu.name: Kid Icarus: Uprising
_cemu.note: 30 fps; its cutscene videos play slowly. No console report yet.

_cemu.name: Super Mario 3D Land
_cemu.note: A tester played it on a Wii U (Nov 9): almost all of it runs without issue, with 3 slow spots in a castle level. In Cemu it runs only in the interpreter (a Cemu bug).

_cemu.name: Miitopia
_cemu.note: 30 fps. Needs your 3DS system files (the Mii data), which the builder now finds or asks for. From this build, 331 more shaders are built in ahead (18 fps became 30 in Cemu).

000400000008C300.name: Tomodachi Life
000400000008C300.note: About 30 fps, as on a 3DS. Saves on the console.

000400000007AE00.name: New Super Mario Bros. 2
000400000007AE00.note: Finished: confirmed on a real Wii U in November 2026 to run as the game should, with no known problems left.

00040000000D5A00.name: Mario & Luigi: Dream Team
00040000000D5A00.note: About 30 fps on a console, slower in a few busy places.

00040000001B8F00.name: Mario & Luigi: Superstar Saga + Bowser's Minions

00040000001D1400.name: Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story + Bowser Jr.'s Journey
00040000001D1400.note: 30 fps on a console. Blowing into the GamePad's mic works, or click the right stick.

00040000000F2F00.name: Professor Layton and the Azran Legacy

00040000000A8500.name: Professor Layton and the Miracle Mask

0004000000055F00.name: Luigi's Mansion: Dark Moon
0004000000055F00.note: Plays 20 minutes into Gloomy Manor in the PC trial without freezing. Not yet tried in Cemu or on a console.
